# Base

This project was generated using [Angular CLI](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli) version 22.2.6.

## Development server

To start a local development server, run:

```bash
ng serve
```

Once the server is running, open your browser and navigate to `http://localhost:4200/`. The application will automatically reload whenever you modify any of the source files.

## Code scaffolding

Angular CLI includes powerful code scaffolding tools. To generate a new component, run:

```bash
ng generate component component-name
```

For a complete list of available schematics (such as `components`, `directives`, or `pipes`), run:

```bash
ng generate --help
```

## Building

To build the project run:

```bash
ng build
```

This will compile your project and store the build artifacts in the `dist/` directory. By default, the production build optimizes your application for performance and speed.

## Running unit tests

To execute unit tests with the [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/) test runner, use the following command:

```bash
ng test
```

## Running end-to-end tests

For end-to-end (e2e) testing, run:

```bash
ng e2e
```

Angular CLI does not come with an end-to-end testing framework by default. You can choose one that suits your needs.

## Additional Resources

For more information on using the Angular CLI, including detailed command references, visit the [Angular CLI Overview and Command Reference](https://angular.dev/tools/cli) page.

    {{ prefs.t('Tabs page', 'صفحة علامات التبويب') }}

{{ prefs.t('How compliance is documented', 'كيف يُوثَّق الامتثال') }}

{{ prefs.t('Hawiyah is maintained independently. It is not an official DGA product and holds no certification, and using it does not certify an application.', 'تُصان هوية بصورة مستقلة. وهي ليست منتجًا رسميًا لهيئة الحكومة الرقمية ولا تحمل أي شهادة، واستخدامها لا يمنح التطبيق شهادة امتثال.') }}

{{ prefs.t('The alignment record therefore states what has been verified against the Platforms Code and what has not.', 'ولذلك يبيّن سجل المواءمة ما جرى التحقق منه مقابل كود المنصات وما لم يُتحقق منه بعد.') }}

  • {{ prefs.t('Alignment record', 'سجل المواءمة') }}
  • {{ prefs.t('Components', 'المكوّنات') }}
  • {{ prefs.t('Templates', 'القوالب') }}
{{ prefs.t('Open an issue in the repository', 'افتح بلاغًا في المستودع') }} `, }) export class Home { readonly prefs = inject(Prefs); readonly repository = REPOSITORY; readonly facts = computed(() => [ { term: this.prefs.t('Version', 'الإصدار'), description: this.prefs.t('0.2.1, before 1.0', '0.2.1، قبل الإصدار 1.0') }, { term: this.prefs.t('Licence', 'الرخصة'), description: 'Apache 2.0' }, { term: this.prefs.t('Packages', 'الحزم'), description: this.prefs.t('Seven, on npm', 'سبع حزم على npm') }, { term: this.prefs.t('Adapters', 'المهايئات'), description: this.prefs.t('Four: JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular', 'أربعة: JavaScript وReact وVue وAngular') }, { term: this.prefs.t('Catalogue', 'الفهرس'), description: this.prefs.t('83 components', '83 مكوّنًا') }, ]); readonly record = computed(() => [ { term: this.prefs.t('Evidence', 'الأدلة'), description: this.prefs.t('A verified requirement is recorded with its source, version and section, how it is implemented, and how that was checked.', 'يُسجَّل كل متطلب جرى التحقق منه مع مصدره وإصداره وموضعه، وطريقة تنفيذه، وكيفية التحقق من ذلك.') }, { term: this.prefs.t('Open items', 'البنود المفتوحة'), description: this.prefs.t('Where the evidence is incomplete, the item stays listed as open.
